Synthetic FastQC 0.12.1 outputs (made up, trimmed to a few modules) for isotable's FastQC parser:

inside an `ERR044595_1M_1_fastqc/` folder) and the R2 mate as an extracted
`ERR044595_1M_2_fastqc/` folder.
